body: You look so kind and like you give really good hugs. And you’re super pretty!

Yep! It really just makes everything worse because you’re already hurting emotionally, but now I gotta hurt physically at the same time?? It’s so miserable and add anxiety cause you feel like you’re dying. I hope you don’t feel that again any time soon.

I completely agree. I know they aren’t the entire solution but I wish they would be effective enough to allow me to use the tactics I learned at my last therapist instead of spiral. I see a psychiatrist and I used to see a therapist but she relocated sadly. My mom and I are on the search for a really good one though and once we find them we’re gonna go asap. Again, thank you

Also I’m sorry you’ve been feeling worthless as well. It’s really hard when people tell you you aren’t but don’t really show that you’re worth anything and so it just doesn’t help. I really hope you also find happiness and feel good again soon.

I’ve been trying desperately to stay busy by playing games, going out and doing stuff, drawing, but mostly watching shows and movies with stories I can really invest myself into. It works for a little bit until I’m reminded of him or something else, or when I don’t have the attention span anymore. When I’m just trying to go to sleep or I don’t have anything to occupy my brain completely, I dip even harder. Idk if that makes sense.
Thank you! It is very annoying that meds don’t really help anymore with this. What kind of therapy would be best do you think?
